caption: 💌 SAVE this recipe for your next peaceful breakfast! 🌿 Soft, real-food muffins made with red beans & apple 🍎 Naturally sweet, full of calm energy with no refined sugar, no chaos. Perfect for tiny hands and peaceful mornings ☁️💛 Recipe: • 1 cup (180g) cooked red beans • 1 (100g) apple  • 1 egg • 2 tbsp honey or maple syrup • 2 tbsp olive oil or any neutral oil • 1/8 cup milk  • 1/4 cup (40g) spelt flour  • 1/4 tsp cinnamon  • 1/2 tsp baking powder Blend until smooth for perfect soft muffins your toddlers will love. Bake in a muffin tray at 180°C for 25 min 👌 ideal for breakfast or snack time. Naturally sweet, full of fiber & protein, gentle on tiny tummies, and perfect for calm mornings. ☁️💛 #toddlersnackideas #calmsnack #realfoodmama #healthytoddlerrecipes #refinedsugarfree
